---
title: "Financial Dashboard"
subtitle: "Interactive market analysis: backtesting, risk metrics and forecasting"
---

An interactive dashboard built in Python and Streamlit. It covers the full loop a quant cares about: pull market data, run technical analysis, backtest a trading strategy, measure risk (Value at Risk, Beta) and forecast prices with Prophet.

## What it does

- **Technical analysis**: price series with common indicators.
- **Backtesting**: run a strategy over historical data and inspect the equity curve.
- **Risk metrics**: Value at Risk and Beta, to size and contextualize exposure.
- **Forecasting**: short horizon price forecasts using Prophet.

## How it is built

- **Streamlit** for the interface and interactivity.
- **Python** (pandas, numpy) for the data and computation, in `logic.py`.
- **`dashboard.py`** as the app entry point.

[Full source on GitHub](https://github.com/laurasalop03/financial-dashboard)
